evidence.quote: 看最新的美联储H4.1文件截止本周三准备金回落到2.96万亿，财政部TGA账户9400多亿美金。再看财政部的国债拍卖表格，到10月底还有多笔债券发行包含bills和coupos，净筹资1320亿美金（Bills净筹资1061亿美元、Coupons净筹资260亿）。这就意味着到了月底TGA大概率还是要升到1.05万亿美金上下的目标区间（也是财政部在8月初设定的10月底目标区间），那么准备金可能会回落2.85万亿美金，基本上就是之前聊到的10月底会出现一个流动性的低点。

evidence.quote: At 14:59 UTC on October 23rd, an attacker exploited a bug in Initia MoveVM’s script caching that allowed malicious code to bypass security checks. No native INIT was minted, and
the total INIT supply is unaffected.

Before the network was halted, the attacker bridged out roughly $2.7M, comprising of 105 WETH and ~1.4M AUSD0 via LayerZero along with ~1.08M USDC via Noble and CCTP. The tokens were swapped for 1,135.52 ETH and currently sit in 0x358ef0130f7a5aa516dcd81bdc80b18cde41cac8 on Ethereum Mainnet.

We are actively working on a security fix to patch the identified vulnerability. We expect this to be completed and audited in a few days. Additionally, asset recovery efforts are ongoing with the help of security partners.

The Initia L1 and Rollups remain halted as we work toward a resolution. We hope to safely resume network operations as soon as possible and will provide a full post-mortem once available. In the meantime, we will continue to share verified updates through our official channels.

A virtual power plant pools small energy resources, like home batteries, smart thermostats and factory equipment that can pause, and runs them together as one big power plant.

And this is where it gets exciting. Under Voltus's "Bring Your Own Capacity" program, Google funds it and counts it toward the power its data centres need in PJM. Google gets a gigawatt from its neighbours using less at the right moment, and the money lands in their pockets.

items.author: chamath
items.new_information: 单Agent+Skills更优，开源迁移工具

evidence.quote: Anthropic 最近开始建议企业「少用点 Subagent」，甚至把一些专家 Agent 重新合并回主 Agent Loop。
他们在多个企业项目中发现，单 Agent + Skills 的效果经常比复杂的多 Agent 架构更好。有个客户改成单 Loop 后，运行速度甚至快了约 2 倍。
他们曾把客服系统里的 Subagent 合并，延迟确实降低了，却让一个原本能完成的任务失败了，因为主 Agent 漏掉了向物流专家确认送达时间这一步。
所以作者强调，每合并一个 Subagent，都要用端到端 Eval 验证，尤其要检查哪些原本通过的任务突然失败了。
Anthropic 还开源了一套迁移工具，可以帮你分析现有架构，逐步合并 Subagent，并比较改动前后的质量、成本和延迟。很推荐做 Agent 工程的朋友试试。
